instruction: I need to change all text in my Impress presentation to use the 'Noto Sans' font. What's the best way to apply this globally across all slides?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing all fonts in a 28-slide presentation from Arial to Noto Sans. Evaluator extracts all unique fonts and verifies only 'Noto Sans' is present.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly iterates through all slides, shapes, text frames, paragraphs, and runs to extract fonts
Metric properly checks if result set contains only the expected font 'Noto Sans'
Postconfig includes save operation with adequate sleep time to ensure file persistence
Complete coverage of the single instruction requirement (all text uses Noto Sans)
Expected value 'Noto Sans' is semantically correct per instruction
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Getter silently skips text runs where font.name is None/empty (line 32). Consider explicitly handling None fonts - either add them to a separate set for validation, or document that null fonts are acceptable
Add edge case handling for empty presentations (currently returns empty set which correctly fails the check)
Consider logging or warning when None/empty fonts are encountered during extraction
